facts.fact: OrthoSynetics claims that practices using it as their orthodontic marketing company generate, on average, 35% more new patient appointments.
facts.quote: Practices that use OrthoSynetics as their orthodontic marketing company generate, on average, 35% more new patient appointments.

facts.fact: OrthoSynetics reports that an Illinois practice received $580,000+ in additional contracts from OrthoSynetics-led digital marketing efforts within 12 months.
facts.quote: In 12 months, an Illinois practice received $580,000+ in additional contracts from OrthoSynetics-led digital marketing efforts.

facts.fact: OrthoSynetics reports that a California practice increased contracts with its marketing by 30% during 2022.
facts.quote: A California practice increased contracts with OrthoSynetics marketing by 30% during an economically challenging 2022.

facts.fact: OrthoSynetics reports that a Florida practice saw a 30% increase in overall website traffic through a more digital-focused marketing strategy.
facts.quote: A Florida-based practice saw a 30% increase in overall website traffic through a more robust digital-focused marketing strategy.

facts.fact: OrthoSynetics reports that a January promotion for a California practice produced a 45% increase in new patient starts compared with the same month the previous year.
facts.quote: A January promotion for a California practice resulted in a 45% increase in new patient starts compared to the same month previous year.
